classification.difficultyReason: Convert both diameters to radii and subtract the volume of an axial cylindrical hole.

content.prompt: A cylindrical hole of diameter $4\text{ cm}$ is drilled through a cylinder of diameter $8\text{ cm}$ and height $16\text{ cm}$. Find the volume of the figure that remains.

spec.description: Upright hollow cylinder with concentric top and bottom rims and hidden axial hole boundaries. Decorative pink shading omitted under house style.
spec.mathematics: Outer radius 4 cm, inner radius 2 cm, common height 16 cm; no numerical labels appear in the source figure.
spec.answerVisibility: No answers or additional measurements shown.

answer.worked:
The outer and inner radii are $4\text{ cm}$ and $2\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\pi(4^2)(16)-\pi(2^2)(16)\\V&=256\pi-64\pi\\V&=192\pi\text{ cm}^3\end{align*}$$
